issues.claim: Sample: held-out normal BACnet/IP captures from at least two ArmaturaSec client sites plus her testbed, with anomalies injected one factor at a time

sources.quote: dedicated ICS testbed equipped with Siemens-compatible PLCs, Modbus/TCP and DNP3 traffic generators, and packet capture infrastructure for long-term dataset collection
A testbed with all three protocol stacks was operated for 45 days

issues.explanation: Kiss's testbed is documented with Modbus/TCP and DNP3 (and EtherNet/IP) traffic generators, not BACnet/IP, so the plan cannot assume her testbed can supply BACnet experiment traffic; list it explicitly as a capability to be confirmed or built, and note that BACnet samples must come from ArmaturaSec (or a new generator).

issues.claim: Proposed fourth step: co-design the alert explanation with two client plant managers and measure whether they can judge an alert actionable unaided
issues.explanation: Nothing in the company material states that client plant managers are willing or available to take part; the step should be phrased as conditional on ArmaturaSec securing two consenting pilot clients (the archives are explicitly shared under consent/NDA), otherwise it reads as an arranged commitment.
